video_title: Would LeBron going to Golden State ruin his LEGACY and they aren't even CONTENDERS 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing LeBron James's championship chances in Cleveland versus Golden State
quotes.excerpt: Which team has a chance to win the whole fucking thing?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Do you think for LeBron it's better for Cleveland or Golden State? Team makeup right now, which team is better? Which team has a chance to win the whole fucking thing?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Are we saying everybody's healthy stays healthy?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I think it's equal either way.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of the path to a championship for Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: You're Cleveland right now, you get LeBron James, you got to worry about the Knicks.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You're Cleveland right now, you get LeBron James, you got to worry about the Knicks. You don't even know what this shit in Boston going to look like. I'm willing to take the road for Cleveland would be a little bit easier than the road for Golden State.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You got to worry about Detroit. You got to worry about a lot of teams.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Eastern Conference path is easier for a championship run
quotes.excerpt: The easier road for LeBron to get a championship is the East.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The easier road for LeBron to get a championship is the East. Let's say you don't, let's see you get a six seed, then your first matchup of the fucking playoffs is San Antonio. You just got a bunch of guys that have been there and won.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: But there's a lot of shit that has to go right in order for them to win.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: The production and legacy impact of LeBron joining Golden State
quotes.excerpt: Think about like the production side of it. You recording everything, right? The last dance.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Think about like the production side of it. You recording everything, right? The last dance, the Chicago bullshit, but you do the last dance, LeBron shit, whatever, however you want to name it. That's just fire.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: As a fan, it would be cool for LeBron's legacy. I would hate to see it.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: And if they don't do it, then it looks like a failure.
